text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Flower-chan! Hey, hey, you're taking 
on the Triple Tiara, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend
text_block_list.text:
"I saw your special feature on TV the 
other day! You're getting tons of 
attention, so do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hm, hm, hm-hmm~♪ Grow big and strong, 
little flowers~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My, aren't we in a good mood?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sky-san, you were there? Since when...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That spot in the shade was so cozy. 
Watching Flower skipping around lightly 
made me feel so pleasantly sleepy~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hyaah~...! I'm acting like a child... 
Please forget that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyaha~. It's fine, isn't it? I mean, 
you've been doing amazing out there 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To think they're calling me the absolute 
favorite for this year's Tiara route...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so grateful. When the press came to 
interview you the other day, Trainer... it 
made me so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I need to work even harder, for your 
success too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...For Trainer's sake as well, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing, isn't it? Because really, 
that's all it takes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you should take a page out of my 
book sometimes and just re~lax, Flower. 
Fretting over things won't do any good 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you know... Flower buds are 
beautiful too, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sky-san...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I'm skipping, though. Spe-chan is going 
to do it too, so don't worry about it~.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —And that's what happened.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what Sky-san was trying to tell 
me?
choice_data_list:
Something like, 'Don't push yourself too 
hard'...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I see. Sky-san is just so kind...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then today, I'll do my best... to not 
overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the break, Nishino Flower was 
supposed to run freely so we could check 
her current abilities.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Haa... phew~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Entering the Classic Year, although my 
physical disadvantages remain, I've 
learned how to manage them. Fatigue 
doesn't linger as much as it did when I 
first debuted."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, if she continues on the Tiara path, 
the next race, the Yushun Himba (Japanese 
Oaks), is 2,400 meters. Can she truly 
overcome it as she is now...?
Oh! Bakushin—full—speed—ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Bakushin indeed! Because I am Sakura 
Bakushin O, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O is an Umamusume of the 
same generation as Nishino Flower. 
Apparently, she aspires to be an exemplary 
figure...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As the Class Rep, I've come to scout 
promising Umamusume of interest! Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yubo...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, you mean me!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Who else could it possibly be? 
Right, Zephyr-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh, Zephyr-san?! Wah! I looked away 
*again*!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Wh-what should we do?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure Bakushin O-san ran off in 
this direction...
—A fragrant scent...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm? Was that just—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (So light and airy...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A balmy early-summer breeze... You carry 
its scent with you, don't you? It brings 
peace to my heart...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Z-Zephyr-san...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who appeared like the wind was 
Yamanin Zephyr... An Umamusume with a 
mysterious aura.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, she ran in the GⅠ Sprinters 
Stakes and continues to do her best to 
make her mark on the sprint and mile 
routes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Zephyr-san!! I knew you came back to 
the rooftop!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You'll get lost again! Make sure you stay 
right behind your class rep!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The breeze reaches this spot nicely. 
Though just now, I was actually thinking 
of heading out to the track.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Flower-san... I wanted to feel your wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was watching your race from here. It was 
like a sudden gale, such magnificent 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! I sense a Bakushin spirit in 
you! I'm certain you will bloom into a 
splendid Bakushin Flower, Miss Flower!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. When that blooms... you will 
likely find yourself facing each other 
directly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It sounded almost like a prophecy. 
However, they are currently focused mainly 
on mile and sprint races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, it doesn't look like their paths 
will cross with the road Nishino Flower is 
walking, but...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now I have something more to look forward 
to. I hope our paths will cross someday.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, no you don't! Next, you're going to 
join me for an exemplary walk!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-san! Please help me with my 
homework again sometime~!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Umm... Wh-What was that all about...?
choice_data_list:
Sounds like it turned into a praise party 
for Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What?! Th-That's definitely not it~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still, both of them said such sweet 
things to me... Ehehe."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the 'current' me... will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I feel ready to give the Oka Sho my all♪
